method.operation: Real UI select all 28 and click batch process on http://127.0.0.1:3080/
method.endpoint: Every scheduled run reaches terminal source-review, failed, waiting-config, or review; verify new persisted snapshots and original bytes
method.clock: Persisted event timestamps for server phases, renderer monotonic elapsedMs for renderer checkpoints, browser performance.now for click-to-render feedback; queue separated from running time
method.cache: Existing live browser prewarmed by readiness, new anonymous contexts; existing profile cookie jar and assets retained; no artificial cache purge
method.changes: No production code or configuration changes; actual UI request updates 28 business article records; before index retained privately
method.exclusions: No invented percentage, no manual source approval, no prompt/plan approval, no image generation; this is a single live network sample per article, not a controlled performance benchmark
method.observer: Read-only state-file watcher plus 1s fallback scan; read time retained; UI MutationObserver and ResourceTiming only

lock.measurement: Read-only file events plus 100ms existence checks. A continuous-visible interval can merge adjacent writer acquisitions; it is not proof of one writer holding the lock for that entire duration.

controlledReproduction.limitation: This demonstrates the failure mechanism; original exceptions from the live failed runs were not preserved.
